name: Skills
description: Discover agent skills — named bundles of instructions, context, and tools. Pick command='list' to render an index, or command='read' for one full skill. Sources are skillsets (directories such as w/skills or v/skills/root); name individual skills with the skills input instead. Read-only — author with covia_write or asset_store.

sources.description: Skillsets to search — directory paths whose keys are skill names. Defaults to this venue's configured entry skillsets (see v/info/adapters/skills), normally ["w/skills", "v/skills/root"]. Earlier sources shadow same-named later skills.

skills.description: Individual skills to include — paths to one skill, or content-addressed asset refs. Distinct from sources, which names directories.

name.description: read only: a skill name from the index, looked up across the sources and skills given.

ref.description: read only: direct skill address (a/<hash>, v/skills/<x>, w/skills/<x>) — alternative to name.

output.description: list → the skill index text (one '- name — description' line per skill), or null when no skills exist. read → {name, description, body?, tools, skills?, context?, path} — skills contains child source refs contributed while loaded; body is present when the skill has content (a contentless skill is a pure toolset).
